inject_prefix: [STATUS: queue={pick_queue_size} picks pending, last ingestion={last_ingestion.ended_at} status={last_ingestion.status}, drift_open={calibration_drift_open}]

status_sources.pick_queue_size: select count(*) from picks where status in ('draft','reviewed')
status_sources.last_ingestion: select ended_at, status from ingestion_runs order by ended_at desc limit 1
status_sources.calibration_drift_open: select count(*) from calibration_drift where resolved_at is null
